adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic.rb`, `expandable_first_post?` was changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`, and there is no replacement guard checking `EmbeddableHost` presence. Since embedding enablement is now effectively controlled by whether any `EmbeddableHost` records exist (e.g., `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`), deleting all allowed hosts would disable embedding requests but would not affect `expandable_first_post?`. Thus, if `embed_truncate` is on and a topic already has a `topic_embed`, the expandable/truncated behavior will remain active even when no embeddable hosts exist, which is a behavior regression relative to the previous guard.
